My opponent wanted one thing only: to stop me.
Me, who might become the next Silver Star.

Was that fear misplaced?
No. Not misplaced at all.

In justice's name I was planning to start a war. A false name for what I was doing. That demon king had scattered pointless conflict again and again. As successor to that one, my qualifications were quite sufficient.

That was what I thought.

Yes. I understood.

Understood it properly.

en.html:
What my tsurugi wanted to say, I knew before she finished.
Already I had felt it.

...Little by little, we were being pushed back.
The balance was shifting. Slowly, steadily, in the direction of our defeat.

My strength—Muramasa's strength—had not fallen.
Flesh and bone were being shaved away. One year of remaining life exchanged for one second of strength. At that price, we kept our fighting power at its peak.

Masamune, the enemy, had a different arrangement.
Peak was not enough. Strongest blow, then a stronger one. Then another one, stronger still. 'Strongest' had become a temporary post.

Each clash: stronger. Harder. More unyielding.

Perhaps Ichijou Ayane, my enemy, had finally shown what being a hero really meant.

A hero did not lose. In the end, the hero always won.
One painful step at a time, climbing the stairs. And at the end of all that effort, obtaining the strength to defeat the enemy. Without fail.

If this continued, I would lose.

As a human being, I accepted it. Deeply impressed, even.

If this continued, I would lose.

But presently I was a fighter. For that mind, accepting the situation was step one of breaking it.

How to turn it around?
————From the beginning, one move.

Let the enemy climb those stairs. I had to reach a height she could not reach that way, however hard she climbed.
A needle's point. No requirement to stay balanced there. Spend every last bit of strength and stand there for one instant. One blow's worth of time.

The finishing move. The full stop.

An electromagnetic draw with my whole being behind it.

ja.html:
劒冑の伝えたいことは、最後まで言葉を聞かずとも
知れた。
　既に感じ取っていた事だった。

　……徐々に押し込まれている。
　次第次第に、力の均衡がこちらの頽勢へ移ろいつつ
ある。

　<ruby>村正<rt>おれ</rt></ruby>の力は衰えていない。
　血肉と骨を削り、一年の余命を一秒分の活力に変え、
最高潮の戦闘力を維持し続けている。

　だが<ruby>正宗<rt>てき</rt></ruby>は違う。
　最高の維持に留まらない。最強の一撃の次には更に
一段上の最強打を。その次には更に上の一打を。

　一合毎により強く。<ruby>剛<rt>つよ</rt></ruby>く。<ruby>靭<rt>つよ</rt></ruby>く。
　
　<ruby>綾弥一条<rt>てき</rt></ruby>は遂に英雄たるの本領を顕したのかもしれ
ない。

　英雄は敗退せず、<ruby>最後には必ず勝つ<rt>・・・・・・・・</rt></ruby>。
　対敵を打ち倒す為の力を、一歩一歩階段を登るにも
似た刻苦の積み重ねの末、必ず手に入れるのだ。

　このままでは敗れる。
　
　俺は人間として、深い感嘆と共にそう認めた。

　このままでは敗れる。
　
　しかし今の俺は戦闘者であり、その意識は現状打開
への端緒としてまずそう認めた。

　状勢を覆すには。
　――――――――元より、一手。

　敵が地道に階段を登るなら、それではどうあっても
届かぬ遥かな高みへ至るまで。

　血肉と骨を削り、一年の余命を一秒分の活力に変え、
最高潮の戦闘力を維持し続けている。

　最高の維持に留まらない。最強の一撃の次には更に
一段上の最強打を。その次には更に上の一打を。

ない。

　英雄は敗退せず、最後には必ず勝つ・・・・・・・・。
　対敵を打ち倒す為の力を、一歩一歩階段を登るにも
似た刻苦の積み重ねの末、必ず手に入れるのだ。

　このままでは敗れる。
　
　俺は人間として、深い感嘆と共にそう認めた。

　このままでは敗れる。

への端緒としてまずそう認めた。

　状勢を覆すには。
　――――――――元より、一手。

　敵が地道に階段を登るなら、それではどうあっても
届かぬ遥かな高みへ至るまで。
　針の先端のような其処へ居座り続ける必要はない。

en.html:
...No.
That would not win.

Masamune had a secret art to shut down secret arts. Swallow the energy of the opponent's Divine Art, change only its direction, send it back.

Divine Art—Immediate Retribution.

Attempt a killing blow against her: a capital crime. Trial held on the spot. Sentence: a killing blow in proportion to the offense. Death. Executed immediately.
No defense accepted. Escape not available. Bow your head and receive God's judgment.

Already I had tasted it once.
I survived only because my own strike had lacked sufficient power.

Send a killing stroke, and it would come back to kill me. Strictly, impartially. Surely not even the smallest error would be permitted.

Use the electromagnetic draw: defeat and death confirmed.
...Don't use it, keep fighting like this: same result.

Toh? What was I to do?

　どうするか。

The worst plan.
The most stupid plan.

At the very end, that was my selection.

Whatever trick I tried: useless.
Whatever trap I arranged: powerless.

Ichijou's justice would not bend for such things.

Call it a blazing sun. Take your little cleverness near it, and before you could even touch it, you would burn away. Self-destruction, fully guaranteed.

If there was one way to extinguish that sun—only one—
it was to smash into it with an equal mass. Or greater.

Ichijou had justice that would not yield.
Masamune had a Divine Art that would not break.

Fine. Both together I would smash.

That alone was the move!

en.html:
Your soul was not yet finished.
Mine also remained.

Arteries and several organs had burst. This body was already on its final countdown. Still, it held my soul to the living world.

Everything left, I would stake on answering your will.
My own will, I would carry through.

We had asked.

Justice.
Evil.
What did they mean? What were they worth? What was their truth?

—Then keep asking.

Till the end.
Till nothing remained of Kageaki Minato and Ichijou Ayane.

Surely so many people before us had staked their lives on that question. Kings. Monks. Knights. Widows. Scholars. Poets. Merchants. Farmers. Beggars.

Its answer, we would keep seeking.
Straight ahead. Down the road each of us had chosen.

ja.html:
お前の魂が尽きないように、
　俺の魂もまだ残っている。

　動脈と臓器のいくつかが弾けた肉体は既に秒読み。
　しかしまだ魂を現世に繋ぎ止めている。

　この、残る全てを賭してお前の意思に報いよう。
　俺自身の意思を貫徹しよう。

　俺達は問うた。

　正義。
　邪悪。
　その意味を、意義を、真実を問うた。

　――問い続けよう。

　最後まで。
　湊斗景明と綾弥一条が尽き果てるまで。

　その命題、
　過去にもきっと数多の人間が――王侯が、僧侶が、
騎士が、寡婦が、学者が、詩人が、商人が、農夫が、
乞食が――身命を賭したのであろう問いの、

　答えを追い求めよう。
　ただ真っ直ぐに、選んだこの道を駆け抜けて。
